detail.longDescription:
Explore 290,000+ courses to build, practice, and apply skills across AI, IT, data science, programming, and pretty much anything else. Trusted by millions worldwide, our marketplace lets you buy courses from real-world experts, one at a time, with lifetime access for as long as it’s available.

Learn on your schedule, right from your device. Whether you're aiming for a promotion, figuring out what's next, or leveling up where you are, find your perfect course, buy it once, and stay ready for whatever's next.

Every course is taught by someone who's an expert in their field, and updated regularly so what you're learning reflects what the field actually needs right now. Our goal is to prepare you for the career you want, not just to help you look good on your resume. 

Why Udemy:

PERSONAL PLAN: Meet your career sidekick. Gain unlimited access to top-rated courses with an active subscription and build, practice, and apply skills across AI, tech, and business. Learn key tools like Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, and Midjourney, and stay ahead with updated content reflecting the most in-demand skills. 

HANDS-ON LABS: Learn by doing with 180+ in-course lab workspaces designed for applied learning and technical skills. (Available with Personal Plan only).

SKILL ASSESSMENTS: Take one of 600+ assessments to see exactly where you stand and what to learn next. (Available with Personal Plan only).

AI ROLE PLAY: Practice what you learn with 1,800+ realistic, AI-powered scenarios integrated into your courses. Get instant feedback and repeat until you’re confident.

REAL-WORLD EXPERTS: Learn directly from industry leaders who work in the field.

CERTIFICATION PREP: Prepare for industry-recognized certifications from AWS, Microsoft, Google, CompTIA, PMI, and more.

AI ASSISTANT: Reach your goals faster with AI-powered conversations that answer learning-related questions about a course. Availability varies by course and plan.

LEARN ANYWHERE: Stream on the go or download courses to keep learning without signal or wifi access.

LEARNING REMINDERS: Stay on track with custom push notifications tailored to your schedule.

PRACTICE ACTIVITIES: Apply what you learn in each section with a quiz, exercise, or project.

NOTES: Capture key lecture moments so you can quickly return to them later.

LIFETIME ACCESS: Come back to any course you purchase through our marketplace whenever you need a refresher for as long as it's available.

CAST TO TV: Watch your courses on the big screen with Chromecast, Apple TV, or AirPlay.

DARK MODE: Adjust for more comfortable learning in low-light conditions.

Ready to make your move? One course is all it takes to start closing the gap between where you are and your next pivot, promotion, side hustle, or goal. And who knows? You might be just one download away from completely transforming your career.
